text: sorry im clearly retarded but i thought i said it did restore itself when it became visible again [Image #22] so uh is this not what you are talking about or ?
resolution: Cleared up the restore-itself confusion with the exact timeline: the user's re-save broke the door file on disk at 18:37, restarts 1-2 loaded the broken file (blank piece, merged outliner), this session then git-restored Door_Wall_1 between their restarts, and restart 3 loaded the restored file — so 'it became visible again' IS the git restore, not self-healing. Verified the user's screenshot matches the restored doc byte-for-byte: SHAPE shows 101 faces = the restored doc's 101 authored groups, and the two outliner rows = its two saved ranges (Door Frame, Door Leaf). Reiterated the standing state: disk still holds the v1 doc so the knob-through-panel persists in world until a successful re-save; the req_3049 tripwire (already hot-reloaded live) will scream at the exact save moment if the range loss recurs.
